items.title: Steve Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 15, 2017
items.q: So you know, and then Glen Gray the next year.

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s pretty amazing. So you know, and then Glen Gray the next year. So it’s in both sides of my family, the love of jazz and blues.

Well you speak well of the music, and I like the idea of your students having a teacher who has the bandstand experience as well as the academic background. So I’m going to wish you well on your gig tonight, with a semi-pick-up situation.
